result.text: So we've completed the first nine chapters of שער היחוד, which form like an introductory section, and now we're at a very exciting point: we're about to start chapter 10, פרק י', and from here on to the end, the מיטעלער רבי is going to be explaining the סדר השתלשלות, the whole process of creation from the top down. So first I want to give a little recap of the points we talked about in the first nine chapters, and these are the ideas we need to keep in mind throughout the rest of the book. So the first thing we talked about is defined what is התבוננות, and we explained that that is עיון, that התבוננות means that we have to study the topic in depth. And we talked about how specifically by understanding it in depth and then focusing on the tangible examples and things that we can understand, which is the idea of בינה, through that we are going to also be able to unlock the more abstract perceptions of חכמה and get that kind of deeper intuition and and new ideas, new insights. And also that it unlocks דעת, and we actually talked about how דעת and בינה have this special relationship where you really need the two to work together, and דעת is the idea of being able to see how the idea is personally relevant to you and having that sense of personal interest and attachment that's very vital to make the the ideas really affect you in your life, and also to really understand them in a deep way. And then we gave an example, oh, I'm sorry, then we talked about תבונה, the idea of applying what we understand, and that's another vital thing that we have to specifically after we understand the theory, we have to then also specifically work to understand how it's applied and do a similar type of process. And התבוננות, understanding the idea will unlock our ability to do that, but we also have to have a specific effort in our learning to always ask ourselves, you know, how does this apply? How can I find applications for that? And practicing that will increase our ability to do that, just like studying בינה will unlock חכמה and all that stuff. Same thing with working to see the application will help us, you know, get the ability to apply it and have it affect our emotions and our actions and everything like that. Then we talked about an example of how all this, these ideas of בינה and חכמה and תבונה, everything and דעת, how all of that works in ממלא כל עלמין, and we specifically chose ממלא כל עלמין because that is really the first topic a person should focus on, because that is where someone can see Godliness in a very personal way, and that's what unlocks this both this ability of בינה of really understanding in a tangible way and to have a דעת, having a sense of its personal relevance to us, which will then allow a person to also understand the ideas of סובב כל עלמין, which is related more to חכמה, and כולא קמיה כלא חשיב, how everything is like nothing to God, which is related more to כתר. And then we talked about some different things we need to balance when we're doing התבוננות. One is the focus on the details, the פרט, versus the general big picture, which is the כלל, and we talked about that each one has an advantage and disadvantage, that the main point is to see the big picture, but if you don't understand the details, you're going to fool yourself and not really understand it truly. So therefore, we need to begin with a general framework and then really focusing on the details, but always looking to see how the details connect back to the big idea. Then we talked about how we have to balance the awareness in any התבוננות that there's always two parts: there's the part that we can understand and experience directly and tangibly, and then there's the part that is abstract, that is beyond our understanding and beyond our direct experience, and we always have to be aware of both of those parts: what God is creating and the Godly force that's creating it, which is really unknowable. Then that leads into the idea of the next chapter, פרק ו', where he talks about how we have to balance in a proper התבוננות a sense of joy from accomplishment, from understanding and mastery, with a sense of humility and awe and wonder of recognizing that it's really something beyond us that we can't understand. And we don't want to lose sight of either of those two feelings. If a person just feels the joy of accomplishment, they lose the humility that's necessary, and if a person only feels, "Oh, I can't understand," then they're not going to really do what they can do and what they need to do for their עבודה to understand and internalize whatever is possible to get. So we we don't want to have false humility, we don't want to have ego, we want to have that balance. Then we talked about how when studying these things, it's important to see how they all string together and become like a single unit. We don't want to just have this vast, encyclopedic knowledge of tons of different levels with all these explanations, that's not the point. The point is to see how everything, putting all that knowledge together, to see how it it functions as a single whole, a single unit, and therefore we can see how God's essence is really being expressed and is present down here. And so in פרק ז' he he gave examples of that with כתר, and then in פרק ח' he gave similar examples to with חכמה and the מדות, and I believe that the reason that he divides it like that is that, you know, כתר is more or the idea of the מקיף, how God's essence transcends everything, but that that idea of that unity applies also ממלא כל עלמין, also in the פנימי levels where God is revealed in a more unique way in each stage, like in wisdom and in the emotions, and even there there's this unity from top to bottom, and we have to see that. And then we finished off in פרק ט with the idea that it's not just enough to see that unity and see how God is present all the way down here and be able to look around the world and see that this is really like God Himself, because then if we only have that sense of unity, we will feel that God is changing and we'll, you know, make the mistake of viewing God in too much of a physical way. And therefore we need to also understand the idea of the צמצום in general and see it at every stage of the סדר השתלשלות, recognizing how there's the essence that's unchanging, and that all of the changes and diversity that we see within the סדר השתלשלות and within the world are only through the light that's being filtered through the through the צמצום. And so, after the צמצום, there are these changes, but the essence that's there is present, but it's really unchanging. And so we're going to learn about those in detail, but these are the kind of the checklist of the things that we need to keep in mind intellectually and emotionally in order to be successful in our study of this ספר, and in general in חסידות, and in general in עבודת השם.
